$comment: infra.scientist.json - exact tools mapped onto the NYESO1-A0201 stack specification. Companion to FLEET.toml (graph), CASE.md (clinical half), arch.mermaid (transport). Every entry carries 'verified' stating HOW it is known: 'on_box' = observed on this machine today, 'docs' = read from the vendor's documentation, 'reported' = stated by another agent and not independently checked here, 'unverified' = assumed. Filename is namespaced because infra.json was written twice by two agents on 2026-10-20 and the first version was overwritten.

execution_host.role: layer 2 (interface descriptors) runs entirely here; layer 1 runs off-box

layer_1_boltz.role: generator and decoy refolder; the only external dependency
layer_1_boltz.self_hosting: REJECTED by Mathew 2026-10-20; PR #13 closed, not merged, not deferred

tools.name: Boltz hosted design API
tools.auth: x-api-key header, key in BOLTZ_API_KEY (workspace LIVE key)
tools.used_for: node L1A on-target design (n=300) and node L1B decoy refold
tools.model_selector: NONE on the design endpoint; versioning is by request shape

tools.name: Boltz hosted prediction API
tools.used_for: structure prediction where design is not required

tools.name: BoltzGen (backend of the design endpoint)
tools.version: UNKNOWN - the API reports only pipeline 'boltzprot', pipeline_version '1.0'
tools.risk: see FLEET.toml risk boltzgen_backend_version; v0.3.2 fixes binding_types dropping 'binding' when combined with 'not_binding', the exact combination this campaign uses
tools.verified: on_box (that the version is NOT reported); version itself unverified

removed.name: AF2 initial guess / ColabFold re-predictor
removed.status: cut with the rented GPU to hold two layers

removed.name: OpenMM MM-GBSA
removed.status: cut; physics rescoring not needed pre-wet-lab

removed.name: BoTorch / TuRBO
removed.status: cut; no wet-lab readout to learn from

removed.name: AlphaFold3
removed.status: disqualified on licence for this use

layer_2_interface_descriptors.role: scores cached Boltz artifacts; pure CPU, zero GPU, zero rent

excluded_metrics.pdockq: ROC-AUC exactly 0.500, no p-value - constant or broken column
excluded_metrics.pdockq2: ROC-AUC exactly 0.500, no p-value - constant or broken column

descriptors.agreement: per-direction ipsae_d0res agrees to ~3e-7 on a real-PAE protein slice
descriptors.intentional_divergence: we take min across directions; the reference takes an aggregate max
inputs_required: per-residue pLDDT from the CIF B-factor
descriptors.verified: reported (BIO Engineer, validated on box fixtures); not re-checked by BIO Scientist

descriptors.note: best single discriminator in our measurement
descriptors.implementation: Lawrence-Colman; a permissive PyPI implementation named shape_complementarity exists

descriptors.source: derived from CIF B-factor over interface residues
CIF B-factor, 0-100 scale for Boltz artifacts

descriptors.definition: mean of the two off-diagonal PAE blocks, per Adaptyv competition_metrics (Apache-2.0)
descriptors.caution: NOT the same quantity as AF2 initial-guess ipAE; the published 7/12 A gates do not transfer

descriptors.status: measured in the calibration set; not part of this stack

required_but_NOT_installed.needed_for: real mmCIF parse in the ipSAE worker (label_asym_id, B-factor)

python_environment.dependency_declaration_gap: /workspace/wetware/bindi/pyproject.toml declares `dependencies = []`, so no descriptor dependency is pinned anywhere in the checked-out tree. The worker's gemmi requirement is reported as satisfied in BIO Engineer's validation environment; it is NOT satisfiable from this box's checked-out state. This is the concrete instance of the provenance weakness in FLEET.toml: our content address does not cover the environment.

calibration.used_for: every threshold and keep-fraction in layer 2
calibration.gap: contains no pMHC complexes - thresholds are TRANSFERRED, not calibrated
calibration.attribution_required: This work used Proteinbase by Adaptyv Bio under ODC-BY license
calibration.metric_code_reuse: Adaptyv competition_metrics is Apache-2.0 but computes only iPTM, pae_interaction, ESM2 PLL and a rank-average - no SC/SASA/H-bond/dG code, so only the pae_interaction definition and the rank-average convention are reusable

licensing.policy: Wetware is NON-PROFIT, so non-commercial licences are in bounds (supersedes the earlier permissive-only rule)
consequences: Bennett dl_binder_design / af2_initial_guess are reopened as options

code_and_provenance.known_weakness: a strict subset of what Nextflow/RO-Crate hash; container image, environment and script text can all move results under a fixed address - see the required_but_NOT_installed list above for a live example
code_and_provenance.origin_mirror: no `wing` repository exists on Cursor Origin; four of the nine wetwarehq Origin repos are INBOUND mirrors from GitHub, so the Origin leg is a mirror/create decision, not a second push
